records.text: Jacob William Roth is a partner at the law firm and Ben Shapiro’s brother-in-law.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: at the bottom of that lawsuit from Brian Harpole it lists a Jacob William Roth a partner of the firm Who also happens to be Ben Shapiro's brother-in-law.

verification.notes: The Harpole docket confirms Jacob William Roth appeared as counsel, and public biographical material identifies him as the husband of Ben Shapiro sister Abigail, making him Shapiro brother-in-law. Available professional references describe Roth as an attorney or associate at Dhillon Law Group, not a partner. One part is confirmed and the partner title is not.

records.text: Are we to believe it is merely a coincidence that Jacob William Roth, Ben Shapiro’s brother-in-law, is listed on the lawsuit against Candace Owens?
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: Because I do not find this to be a coincidence on the last page of the lawsuit against me, his brother-in-law is listed, Jacob, Jacob William Roth. ... Are we to believe that this is just a happy coincidence?

verification.notes: The factual premise is supported: Jacob William Roth later appeared for Harpole and public biographical material identifies him as Ben Shapiro brother-in-law. The statement primary point—that the appearance was coordinated rather than coincidental—is an inference for which no direct evidence was found.
